capabilities: search emails, phones, domains and usernames via the Sherlockeye API
run CPF and CNPJ searches for Brazil
perform deep searches for expanded results
create notes automatically from search results
search selected text or file titles from the right-click menu
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README states an API key from sherlockeye.io is required but does not say whether the service is paid.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run OSINT lookups on selected text and turn the results into organized vault notes.
summary: Sherlockeye OSINT API integration that searches emails, phones, domains, usernames and Brazilian CPF/CNPJ records and saves results as notes.
